title: The startup job list.
description: Ten places to find startup jobs that beat scrolling LinkedIn, with the link to each and what it's best for.

blocks.text: I got my startup job without applying anywhere. You still need to know which companies are hiring, though.
These are the ten places I'd look: boards built only for startups, the YC and VC portfolio boards, and the Hacker News thread hundreds of companies post in every month.

items: Ten job sites, each with its link and what it's best for
The VC boards that list every role across their portfolios
The monthly thread most people have never heard of
How to use the list to skip the queue

blocks.text: A job board puts you in the same queue as everyone else, so the list ends with how to get out of it.
